To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
online tourist communities can change travel information quality and that the change is positive.

the information quality of online travel information communities has improved significantly in recent years and that this improvement can be attributed to the development of more advanced online communities.
the information retrieved from online tourism communities is more timely, more personalized, more complete and better structured than that from a traditional travel guide book.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of travel information and how this quality can be improved.
the question of whether online communities can provide better travel information quality than traditional sources and, if so, which online tourism community is the best.
the question whether and to what extent online communities are able to improve the quality of travel information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

traditional online tourism communities have already improved the quality of travel information, but that the quality can still be improved further by the introduction of Wiki, personal space, and mobile communities.
online tourism communities can improve the quality of information for travel decision making.
the quality of travel information is higher in advanced online tourism communities than in traditional online communities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
online tourism communities can change travel information quality.
tourism communities have a potential to change the information quality of travel systems.
online tourism communities have a great potential to improve the quality of travel information and thus to influence the behavior of tourists and their travel choices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of online travel information is a major factor that influences travel behavior and that online communities can provide higher information quality than commercial information systems.
tourism communities are able to change information quality.
the younger generation of travelers is not just a new market segment but also a new market for tourism communities that are able to provide the right information at the right time.
